rules: Recommend permanent removal only with direct official evidence explicitly establishing permanent closure of the exact outlet.
SFA absence alone is not closure evidence; current SFA presence is recorded only as a current licence-list cross-check.
Recommend public-access removal only where official evidence explicitly restricts entry to a closed group or authorized persons.

sources.limitation: SFA Track Records is a current result set, not a closure register. Presence does not prove the outlet is operating; absence is not used to infer closure.

sources.observed: Official notice says Satay by the Bay will close from 2026-10-01 to make way for a refreshed waterfront dining experience as part of Wetlands by the Bay development.
sources.interpretation: Direct evidence that the named venue is closed from the stated date. It does not say permanently closed and does not identify whether individual licensed tenants will relocate or reopen elsewhere.

sources.observed: Current Dine & Shop directory page observed; it directs visitors to the live Opening Hours & Closures page for operating status. Satay by the Bay is omitted from the currently rendered dining directory.
sources.interpretation: Supports current venue-level non-listing only; it is not evidence of permanent closure for each stall.

sources.observed: Visitor Pass terms state that a pass grants one individual access to NUS buses and dining at NUS canteens and food courts as specified on the pass; unauthorized access types can be denied and visitors may be asked to verify identity or visit purpose.
sources.interpretation: NUS canteen access is conditional on a valid pass/access type. The terms do not establish that the pass is unavailable to the general public, so this alone is insufficient to classify the exact outlets as private-only.

sources.publisher: NUS Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences / IPSA-NUS Methods School
sources.observed: 2026 information says Methods School participants have access to NUS cafeterias, restaurants and cafes, and identifies The Deck as the FASS canteen.
sources.interpretation: Confirms access for programme participants, not unrestricted access for all members of the public.

sources.observed: The current notice describes specific UTown Food Court access restrictions on weekdays from 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-09, and says campus visitors during that period need licensed student tour guides. This period ended before the observation date and the listed food courts are not the three exact records in this review.
sources.interpretation: Not applied as a current restriction to The Deck or Yusof Ishak House records.

sources.publisher: NUS Lee Kong Chian Natural History Museum
sources.observed: Visitor-facing page lists food outlets at Yusof Ishak House, including Central Square food court.
sources.interpretation: Shows NUS itself directs visitors to Yusof Ishak House dining options, but does not specifically verify access to each licensed outlet below.

limitations: This is a bounded review, not a nationwide closure audit.
The Gardens by the Bay announcement concerns the venue and does not state whether tenants permanently ceased, will relocate, or will resume at a refreshed site.
The NUS sources do not establish a current, universally available guest pass or unrestricted walk-in policy for the exact stalls.
Six additional stalls at the same Gardens by the Bay #01-19 address and unrelated campus/outlet candidates were outside this 15-record batch.
integration_status: 12 venue closure follow-up notes and 3 NUS access notes applied; no removals
